Multiple Companies Announce Financial Results and Board Updates

Several companies, including Asian Hotels (West) and various Australian entities like Electro Optic Systems Holdings Limited, AVITA Medical, Inc., New Hope Corporation Limited, Suncorp Group Limited, Perpetual Limited, Bapcor Limited, and Beach Energy Limited, have released their latest financial results, board updates, and stock exchange disclosures.
